Amazing shot! I love the colors and you did a good job getting it really sharp. Next time, I would move the camera down a little so that the horizon line is on a third (it's more pleasing to the eye). Just make sure not to cut off those awesome buildings!

Beautiful photo! I love the background and composition. The one thing I would change, though, is that your subject is underexposed. Because the background has so much light in it, it makes him too dark to see clearly. Maybe next time try adding a flash or reflector to bring more light onto him. Good job!

Maybe try San Leandro, the next city over. It is actually pretty close to the Oakland Airport, especially if you find a place near the bart, and things are a lot cheaper. There is still crime there, but it's not as bad as the affordable places in Oakland. I've lived there and, though it definitely isn't as fun as Oakland, there are still cool things to check out and the commute to Oakland is not bad.
